release_notes: Renderer Pulls is now draggable from its title bar like normal COLONY windows.
Pulse Glass RUN now behaves as RUN & PLAY: City Island opens or comes to the front, Renderer Pulls minimizes to the dock, and the live score keeps updating while you play.
A small Pulse Glass score HUD stays visible over COLONY during the play test; click it to reopen Renderer Pulls.
Pulse Glass remains experimental/unbenchmarked and still uses only measured City Island metrics for its score.
